title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.
* 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

As a Data Center Technician, you'll deploy and maintain Google's advanced Data Center Server and Network Infrastructure by installing, configuring, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing hardware and server software. You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, bridges, and switches. You will participate in or lead local project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.

In this role, your duties range from the physical deployment of data center related technology to working closely with various stakeholders. It will fall on you to ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of data centers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g., machine learning platforms, network architecture).
* Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently.
* Execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
* Collaborate with the partner teams (e.g., Program Managers, Data Center Operations, Software and Hardware Engineers) to complete tasks, escalate and resolve defined problems.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Principal Robotics Engineer (Motion Control)
description:
**About Asiacruit**

At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a **Principal Robotics Controls Engineer (Locomotion & MPC/RL)** to lead the development of locomotion, dynamic balance, and real-time motion control systems for advanced legged robots.

You will design and implement control algorithms that enable robots to navigate uneven terrain, transition between gaits, recover from external disturbances, and execute movements reliably. The role combines robotics dynamics, model predictive control, reinforcement learning, simulation, and real-world hardware validation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development of the locomotion and motion control stack for legged robots.
* Translate high-level navigation goals into stable, executable robot movements.
* Design and implement nonlinear **Model Predictive Control (NMPC),** **Whole-Body Control (WBC)**, and related optimization-based control methods.
* Develop locomotion policies using deep reinforcement learning where appropriate.
* Implement robot kinematics, dynamics, state estimation, contact detection, and slip-recovery algorithms.
* Develop and validate gait transitions, obstacle negotiation, stair climbing, and recovery from external disturbances.
* Build simulation-based training and testing pipelines using **NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim**, or comparable robotics simulation environments.
* Develop **Sim-to-Real** workflows to transfer locomotion policies from simulation to physical robots.
* Integrate motion control systems with motor controllers and communication networks, including **CAN-FD** and **EtherCAT**.
* Optimize control performance for low-latency, deterministic execution on real-time Linux systems.
* Collaborate with mechanical, embedded, perception, and AI teams to validate complete robotic systems.

**Qualifications**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 8 years of practical experience in robotics, motion control, legged locomotion, or closely related control engineering.
* Strong understanding of robot kinematics, rigid-body dynamics, and multi-body systems.
* Hands-on experience developing locomotion or motion control algorithms for legged robots.
* Strong proficiency in modern **C++** and **C++20**.
* Practical experience with **Model Predictive Control (MPC), nonlinear optimization, and Quadratic Programming (QP).**
* Experience with **Whole-Body Control (WBC)** or related model-based control approaches.
* Familiarity with robotics libraries and frameworks such as Pinocchio, Drake, or OCS2.
* Experience with reinforcement learning for robotics or locomotion policy development.
* Familiarity with **NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim,** or equivalent simulation platforms.
* Understanding of real-time control and **PREEMPT\_RT** Linux environments.
* Experience integrating control software with physical robot hardware and motor communication systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to lead complex robotics engineering projects.

**Why Join?**

* Lead the development of advanced robotic locomotion and control systems.
* Work on challenging problems involving dynamic balance, terrain traversal, and autonomous movement.
* Combine control theory, simulation, reinforcement learning, and physical robot testing.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to move robotics research into practical applications.

description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.

**Technical Knowledge**


* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.

**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in a global, virtual and matrix organization.

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence:** Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.

**Stakeholder Leadership:** Influences global teams, suppliers, customers and leaders through credibility, clarity and constructive challenge.
